response.query: What exact pre-analytics SOPs (anticoagulant type, time-to-spin, plasma volumes, tissue fixation windows, microsampling limits) will be standardized across sites?
response.answer: Standardized pre-analytics SOPs include using EDTA as anticoagulant, spinning plasma within 30 minutes, plasma volume limits of 4-6 mL, tissue fixation within 24 hours, and microsampling limits of 100 µL.
